item.title: Note Taking
item.description:
Obsidian

Todo list

  • recording button start/stop

What is it ?

→ A folder of notes on a computer. Files in markdown.

You organizes notes into files into folders.

There is a note view which collect all links created, even orphans, and show how they relates.

If I click on an orhpan link, I can straight edit a new file with this title.

For me, that would mean more relying on link in my files. Maybe there is a plugin to develop for the Graph view.
